description: Catalog of legal document templates sourced from Common Paper's CC BY 4.0 licensed agreements, stored in the templates/ directory.

templates.name: Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement (Standard Terms)
templates.description: Standard terms for a mutual non-disclosure agreement (MNDA) that lets two parties disclose confidential information to each other while evaluating a potential business relationship.

templates.name: Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement (Cover Page)
templates.description: Cover page used with the Mutual NDA Standard Terms to capture the purpose, effective date, term, and governing law for a specific mutual non-disclosure agreement.

templates.name: Cloud Service Agreement
templates.description: Standard terms governing a customer's subscription to and use of a provider's cloud-hosted software product, covering access, support, payment, data privacy, warranties, liability, and confidentiality.

templates.name: Design Partner Agreement
templates.description: Agreement for early-access design partner programs, granting a partner early product access in exchange for feedback used to develop and improve the product.

templates.name: Service Level Agreement
templates.description: Standard terms defining uptime and support response time commitments, how they are calculated, and the service credits or termination rights available if they are not met.

templates.name: Professional Services Agreement
templates.description: Standard terms for engaging a provider to perform professional services under one or more statements of work, covering deliverables, intellectual property, payment, and warranties.

templates.name: Data Processing Agreement
templates.description: Standard terms governing the processing of personal data by a provider on behalf of a customer, including subprocessors, international data transfers, security incident response, and audit rights.

templates.name: Software License Agreement
templates.description: Standard terms for licensing on-premises or client-side software to a customer, covering the license grant, restrictions, updates, warranties, and liability.

templates.name: Partnership Agreement
templates.description: Standard terms for a business partnership between two companies, covering mutual obligations, trademark licensing, payment, and confidentiality.

templates.name: Pilot Agreement
templates.description: Standard terms for a time-limited pilot or trial of a product, allowing a customer to evaluate the product before entering into a longer-term definitive agreement.

templates.name: Business Associate Agreement
templates.description: Standard terms required under HIPAA for a business associate that creates, receives, maintains, or transmits protected health information (PHI) on behalf of a covered entity.

templates.name: AI Addendum
templates.description: Standard addendum supplementing a product agreement to govern the use of AI features, including input/output ownership, model training restrictions, and AI-specific disclaimers.
